name: [🎃] A Modded Adventure
desc:
Welcome to A Modded Adventure (AMA)! 
Information for Stands, Updates, Sneak Peaks, Giveaways and more in our community server! 
A lot of assets are owned by A Bizarre Day. https://www.roblox.com/games/2686500207

If a player is exploiting then please use our report feature:
!report [Username] [Reason]

Make sure to join https://www.roblox.com/communities/34130196 for additional benefits!

A PC or Mobile device is required to play, we do not support console. Please like our game (someone botted our game dislikes). JoJo's Bizarre Adventure is owned by Hirohiko Araki. A lot of audios and voice lines are from the games Eyes of Heaven, All Star Battle, League of Legends and Heritage for the Future.
